text:
jiwoo: Postmortem follow-up from the recent throughput/latency flare. Need concrete owners for remediation items, a short ETA plan, and the SLO tracking changes before next week's customer review. Keeping this tight.

oscar: Short summary: rapid autoscaler oscillation + cross-zone cache churn caused repeated p95 and occasional p99 spikes over ~8 hours. We've seen a similar fingerprint twice in the last 21 days. Error budget impact: ~2.1% this billing window.

trina: My take: we should avoid any permanent SLO relaxation. Immediate steps: (1) low-priority queue backpressure, (2) short-term autoscaler dampening, (3) recurrence-focused dashboarding.

ioscar: Suggest owners: autoscaler dampening -> oscar; cache eviction audit -> trina; recurrence dashboard & alert -> infra.

oscar: Proposed autoscaler plan (ETA 3 weeks): week1 bench and stability tests; week2 staging canary; week3 controlled prod roll. I'll add bench scripts to infra repo and link.

infra: I'll build a "recurrence" dashboard tile showing: counts of p95 breaches per 24h, zone heatmap, and a 30-day rolling recurrence rate. ETA 2026-04-07. Draft alert below to only page on sustained recurrence:

```
alert: ServiceLatencyRecurrence
expr: increase(service_request_latency_p95[24h]) / max(1, increase(service_request_count[24h])) > 0.12
for: 90m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/runbooks/recurrence.md
  summary: "Sustained p95 recurrence detected across zones"
```

trina: That for: 90m window seems reasonable to avoid blips. Also add a small panel that counts identical incident fingerprints so we can detect repeats faster.

ioscar: For short-term guardrails I'll open a tiny feature-flag PR to cap batch sizes and enable priority queuing for background work. Plan: PR today, staging canary tomorrow. ETA full rollout in 72h if green.

product: For SLA posture: do not change SLOs yet. Track closely. If error budget continues >2% after these mitigations for the next billing period we will prepare a customer-facing note and product will own communications.

jiwoo: Actions & owners (please ack):
- autoscaler dampening + bench: oscar, ETA 2026-04-14
- cache eviction audit + small TTL experiment: trina, ETA 2026-04-05
- recurrence dashboard + alert: infra, ETA 2026-04-07
- short-term backpressure flag PR: oscar, ETA 2026-03-31
- postmortem tracker update & status cadence: jiwoo, ETA 2026-03-31 (weekly updates)

ioscar: ack 0:05. Bench infra PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/bench/pulls/7

trina: ack 0:08. Will post audit plan by EOD tomorrow.

infra: ack 0:12. Dashboard PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/dashboards/pulls/120

jiwoo: I'll publish a short "operational window" note on the SLO dashboard explaining interim guardrails and how recurrence is handled. If any owner misses ETA ping me and we'll escalate.

slo-bot: Scheduled canary rollout by oscar at 3977783000. Notifying oncall rotation.

jiwoo: Closing note: primary objective is to stop error-budget bleed without adjusting customer-facing SLOs. If recurrence persists post-rollout (measured as >2 incidents in 30 days or >2% budget burn next month) we escalate to product for SLA review. Weekly status updates in this thread. :memo:
